newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan one-month NCDs average yield at 5.696 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan one-month NCDs average yield at 5.696 pct.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank issued T$5 billion in one-month negotiable certificates of deposits on Saturday at an average yield of 5.696 percent, a central bank official said.
The range of the bids was between 5.60 and 5.75 percent and demand totalled T$12 billion.
The central bank has said its recent series of NCD issues were intended to absorb extra liquidity from the banking system and not to dampen stock market activity as many analysts have suggested.
